subject: SCI
label: Grade 01
task: Meet the outcome of every unit in Grade 01 Science, and keep one piece of evidence for each.
condition: A 36-week school year, 7 units, a teacher or guide, a learning book or device, and local examples in the local language first with English support.
standard: Each unit: at least 4 of 5 attempts correct, said or written, with one real example from home or school. Course pass: no unit at 'Not yet' after one retry, and a pass in SA1 and SA2.

modules.title: My body and my senses
modules.outcome: name main body parts and match each sense to its organ
modules.intro: In this unit you work on 'My body and my senses', taught in a way that is short, playful, with objects, pictures and talk. The target is clear: name main body parts and match each sense to its organ. You move from seeing it, to saying it, to doing it alone.
points: Observe: see, touch, measure or watch a safe demonstration linked to 'My body and my senses' and write what you notice.
Explain: use the key words of the unit to say what is happening and why, in a few lines.
Use it: name main body parts and match each sense to its organ. Use a diagram, table or short calculation where it fits.
Test and conclude: say what evidence supports your answer and what you would change.
modules.example: Model run for 'My body and my senses'. Question: what do we want to find out? Prediction: one sentence. Method: three safe steps with the equipment named. Record: a small table with units. Conclusion: one sentence that uses the evidence and the key words of the unit. What a good answer looks like: a fair test, measured values with units, and a conclusion that matches the table.
modules.activity: About 20 to 30 minutes of class work, then one short practice task for home. Keep evidence: one page in your learning book.
modules.standard: Name main body parts and match each sense to its organ: at least 4 of 5 attempts correct, said or written, with one real example from home or school.

Which action verb starts the outcome of Unit 1 (My body and my senses), and at which Bloom level is it?
'name', at the Remember level.
When do the formative checks FA1 to FA4 and the summative checks SA1 and SA2 happen?
FA1 to FA4 around weeks 6, 12, 24 and 30; SA1 in week 18; SA2 in week 36.
In which weeks does Unit 7 (Materials) run?
Weeks 33 to 36.
What evidence do you keep for each unit, and why?
One page in your learning book. It shows what you can really do and lets a teacher check it against the standard.
ladder: L1: observe, sort and describe the living and non-living world.
L2: run simple tests and explain with key words.
L3: use models and equations; plan a fair test.
L4: link physics, chemistry and biology ideas with calculation.
L5: specialise; design, analyse and evaluate experiments.
L6 (degree): laboratory science, instrumentation and analysis.
L7 (postgraduate): research design and expert practice.
